style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality chitin shading, matte, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical, low angle, orbital drift; pushes in from 2.5s to hold padlock, scanner pad, Bee Cashier's bag-flank, no cuts
character: WASP: burst-start zero to full speed; two-phase stop, wings jerk once more; double head-jerk overshoot; wings clap out of sync; same design throughout
cast: BEE CASHIER: heavy monolithic clerk, decides from the torso, lands full-weight, one full-amplitude swing, an old open bag at her side; same design throughout
props: hive-computer: branch wax comb as one screen; grid of bright colorful icons, logo-like but abstract, no letters, no logos; woven blind rolled above frame; slim antenna on top; padlock on a hinge; flat scanner pad in bee's thorax; one nectar drop nearby
setting: sunlit meadow, high noon, the branch is the only support
lighting: hard overhead midday sun, crisp highlights, strong contrast

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry deadpan, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: even rate, ~4.3-4.5 syll/sec, adjoining lines, no gaps, room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts open and close each syllable, voice comes from the wasp, not a voiceover
audio.pronunciation: «плачу»: stress on second syllable, pla-CHOO not PLA-cha; even pace, no pause before it

timeline.a: Burst-start, chest slams the screen, rebounds a body-length, two-phase stop: body locks, wings jerk once more
Double head-jerk overshoot at the padlock; a leg reaches the hinge, recoils, body rocks
Bee drops onto the branch, full weight, branch sways; one torso-turn spins the screen to the lens, icons flare on
Wasp hits the grid in a hit-bounce-hit series; each icon blinks out, jerks sideways; after the third hit, grimaces
Jabs the center icon; blind snaps down over the grid, big VPN letters on its face, padlock clangs shut over its edge, knocks her back half a body-length
Bee turns to the lens, padlock and scanner pad fill the frame, VPN blind behind her shoulder
timeline.camera: push-in begins, holds to the end

timeline.a: Stinger presses flat on the pad; spark, two-tone signal, yanks back sharply, body sways
Padlock hangs shut, antennae flick once, weight shifting back for the lunge
Body snaps sideways, wings blur, chest and forelegs slam onto the nectar drop with a splash, droplets scatter, rocks back upright; mouthparts open each syllable
Bee Cashier throws her weight onto the shackle, turns it half a circle; wasp's mouth moves for the line
Shackle springs open with a click; wasp's mouth moves for the line
Wasp's wings clap shut in one sharp sweep, her mouth only moves for the line; behind her, Bee Cashier swings the open bag up and scoops the scattered nectar into it
Bee Cashier balls the nectar into a dollar-sign lump in the bag, seals her mandibles over it with a grin, wasp lunges past the VPN blind into the gap
Sharp push, she's inside, screen slams shut with a thud, dust puff; antenna snaps upright, pulses three widening rings; head snaps to lens, abdomen trembles

negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody; slow speech; extra insects, human hands; real brand logos, readable letters besides VPN and $ lump, watermark, subtitles; foreign accent; cuts, static camera, locked-off; floating objects, duplicate props; extra limbs, character changing mid-shot
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses, slams, or fills frame — never only a small limb moving alone
